name: com.fileion/fileion
title: Fileion
description: Read-only software directory: official sources, SHA-256 hashes, versions, formats, install commands.

tools.name: search_software
tools.description: Search the Fileion software directory by name. Returns up to 10 titles per page with their platforms and Fileion page address. Modified apps (changed copies of someone else's app) are left out; unofficial ones are listed with their label.

query.description: Part of the software name, e.g. "vlc".

tools.name: get_software
tools.description: Details of one software title from Fileion: publisher, category, license, platforms and the latest version on each platform, with the Fileion page address.

slug.description: The title's slug, as search_software returns it, e.g. "vlc-media-player".

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: The published versions of one software title on Fileion, newest first (10 per page): version, platform, release date, file hashes and "N of 5 checks passed", each with its Fileion page address.

slug.description: The title's slug, as search_software returns it.

tools.name: check_download_link
tools.description: Is this web address a source Fileion knows? Answers known or unknown, and for a known one the kind (official, store, mirror, fileion or vendor) and the title with its Fileion page address. For one of Fileion's own download links it names the file that link serves, where that file comes from, and the "N of 5 checks passed" list. The address is only compared with Fileion's records and is never fetched. Unknown means Fileion has no record of the link; it is not a warning.

url.description: A full http(s) address: host and optional port only, no user name or backslash.

tools.name: lookup_file_hash
tools.description: Is this file one Fileion has scanned? Takes the SHA-256 (or SHA-1 / MD5) of a download. If found: the title, version, file, "N of 5 checks passed", the official source host and the Fileion page address. Not found means Fileion has no record of the file; it is not a warning.

hash.description: The file's SHA-256 (64 hex characters), SHA-1 (40) or MD5 (32).

tools.name: recent_updates
tools.description: What is new on Fileion, newest first, with each Fileion page address: new software versions (optionally for one platform), tools, Q&A questions, and blog posts and news. Pick one section or leave it as all (a few of each). Modified apps are left out of the software; unofficial ones carry their label.

section.description: software, tools, qna (questions), articles (blog posts and news) or news (news only). Default all.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the free online tools on Fileion (PDF, image, text and other tools) by name or short description. Returns up to 10 tools per page with their category and Fileion page address.

query.description: Part of the tool name or description, e.g. "merge pdf".

tools.name: search_questions
tools.description: Search the questions asked on Fileion Q&A by their title. Returns up to 10 questions per page, newest first, with the number of answers, whether one was accepted, and the Fileion page address. The answers' text is not returned; it is on the page.

query.description: Part of the question title, e.g. "install vlc".

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search the articles published on Fileion (blog posts and Fileion News) by title. Returns up to 10 articles per page, newest first, with the topic, author name, date and Fileion page address. The article text is not returned; it is on the page.

query.description: Part of the article title, e.g. "download manager".

type.description: Only blog posts or only news.

tools.name: compare_software
tools.description: Compare 2 to 4 software titles from Fileion side by side: publisher, license, platforms, latest versions, pros, cons and key features, plus the feature rows Fileion editors checked by hand (yes, partly or no, with the date). Gives the Fileion "A vs B" page when the first two have one.

slugs.description: 2 to 4 title slugs, as search_software returns them, e.g. ["google-chrome", "mozilla-firefox"].

tools.name: lookup_format
tools.description: What a file extension is (mp3, pdf, heic): its kind, licence, MIME type and typical size, the programs that work with it by system, and the Fileion format page.

extension.description: A file extension with or without the dot, e.g. "mp3" or ".heic".

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: The install commands Fileion has for a software title: package-manager commands (winget, Chocolatey, Scoop, Homebrew), silent-install switches, the installer file name and SHA-256, and the Fileion install page. The commands are quoted, never run, and each says where it came from.

slug.description: The title's slug, as search_software returns it, e.g. "vlc-media-player".
